SHOT: Extreme macro, 4:5, of a short arc of the band, close: three pale aqua emerald-cut stones set end to end ALONG the band, each stone LONGER along the band than across it (its long side follows the band), each in its own polished gold box joined to the next, resting on the top face of a cream plaster cube. Camera very close; the piece fills about two thirds of the frame; razor-sharp on the stones and the metal edges, the rest falling softly out of focus.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is our approved packshot of this exact piece and the ONLY authority on what it is: copy its construction, proportions, metal colour and stone colour EXACTLY; ignore its cube and its background. IMAGE 1 is a close view, so the piece's SIZE in this picture comes ONLY from the SCALE TEST below. IMAGE 2 is the authority for the plaster, the background and the light only.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: AN AQUA EMERALD-CUT BAND: a gold tone band about 4.5mm wide set with a row of rectangular EMERALD-cut stones in a soft pale AQUA blue, each in its own closed polished gold bezel box, set end to end around the band, their long sides running along it. All stones the same pale aqua blue, all emerald-cut rectangles, never round, never oval; each in a closed box bezel, never claws; never a different colour.

SCALE TEST: Each stone is about 4x6mm; the band about 4.5mm wide.

LIGHT: Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a bright moving highlight and a dark rolled edge on every curve, and every stone shows internal sparkle and a hard white point, never flat colour.

ABSENCE LIST: No hand, no ear, no model, no fabric, no props. No second piece of jewellery. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge. A clean modern digital photograph: no creases, no fold lines, no aged-paper texture, no scratches, no film grain.

Keep EVERYTHING else in IMAGE 1 exactly identical: the two rings, the chain's path, the other five charms, the hand, the skin, the pose, the garment, the background, the light, the framing and the camera.
